info.name: School Management System API
info.description:
Run one of the **Login as ...** requests first. It stores the JWT in the `token` variable, and every other request sends it as a Bearer token.

All seeded accounts use the password `Password123!`. Running the whole collection in order works: it ends the Auth folder logged in as admin, and requests that create data clean up after themselves (the grade history keeps a record of the demo grade, by design).

Login is rate-limited to 5 attempts per minute, so wait a minute between two full runs.

request.description: Returns the logged-in user. Try it after each login to see the different profiles.
Invalidates every token of the logged-in user (all devices).
The token used before logout is rejected with 401.
Kept last in the folder, so running the whole collection continues as admin.
Admins see every class, teachers only their own. Saves the first class id as {{classId}}.
Mathematics, 2 hours per week, taught by teacher@school.test, in the class created by Classes > Create class.
Monday to Friday, lessons sorted by period.
Uses the teacher token saved by Auth > Login as teacher. Students get their class timetable here.

Slots where both the class and the subject's teacher are free. The timetable editor offers them when a slot is taken or the teacher is busy elsewhere.

request.description: Uses the student token and class id saved by Login as student (for My grades). A student can open their own class (subjects, teachers, homeroom teacher); any other class returns 403.
Saves the grades of many students of a class in one transaction: all or none. This is how the reviewed results of "Scan tests" are saved. The next request deletes the grade again.

request.description: Sends two sample photos from docs/sample-tests (paths relative to docs/postman; in the Postman app, set docs/postman as the working directory or pick the files again). The AI (Gemini or Claude) reads the student and the grade on each one, or simulated results in demo mode without an AI key. Nothing is saved: the reviewed results are saved with "Give grades in bulk".
The subjects the user can import grades for, each with its classes: everything for an admin, their own teaching assignments for a teacher.

An .xlsx for every class where the teacher teaches Mathematics (add classId for one class): Class, Reg. no., Last name, First name, a Grade column that only accepts 1-10 and an optional Date column. No ids in the file.

Reads docs/sample-grades/grades-9A.csv (Romanian headers, ; separator, dates as DD.MM.YYYY; path relative to docs/postman) for all the teacher's classes: rows are matched by reg. no., else by class and name. Nothing is saved: the reviewed rows are saved with POST /grades/batch, which also accepts a date per grade and replaceGradeId.
Enrolls the student in {{classId}} (set by Classes > List classes).
classId: null removes the student from their class.
